verdict.rationale: Fivetran's connector docs explicitly state re-sync is supported at both connection level and table level, with parent-table resyncs also handling child tables (fivetran-docs-48), and sync-mode docs describe History Mode/backfill semantics (fivetran-docs-35). Community reports corroborate Fivetran performing full/partial re-syncs without pipeline rebuilds (fivetran-comm-10). Missing for 10: a general platform-wide REST API reference for triggering table-level resync (beyond one connector example) and broader independent confirmation across multiple connector types.
